overview.description: The State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR Premium Income ETF (XLKI) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Technology Select Sector index. The fund is an actively managed fund of funds that provides exposure to the US technology sector through the Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLK). It aims to generate income by selling short dated listed call options on its equity holdings XLKI was launched on Jul 29, 2025 and is issued by State Street.
